privacy_limitation: The implementations were generated by local Ollama models and remain gitignored, but a hosted Codex orchestration session observed their source while saving and repairing them. This run therefore does not prove the end-to-end no-code-transmission invariant. That requires a fully local bootstrap installer and an independently observed network-denial test.
scope: This proves two different local seed models can produce behaviorally compatible nodes for the current public vectors. It does not prove secure aggregation, useful model training, Sybil resistance, production payment, sandbox escape resistance, or the no-code-transmission invariant.
